author: clee30
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build arm64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY cannot be linked into another target

failed_jobs.name: Build x64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY cannot be linked into another target

key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_auto_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into
  another target.  One may link only to INTERFACE, OBJECT, STATIC or SHARED
  libraries, or to executables with the ENABLE_EXPORTS property set.
  Call Stack (most recent call first):
    cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:325 (ov_target_link_plugins)
    cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 (ov_generate_plugins_hpp)
    CMakeLists.txt:196 (include)
root_cause: The CMake `ov_generate_plugins_hpp()` function in `cmake/extra_modules.cmake` calls `ov_target_link_plugins()` which invokes `target_link_libraries()` attempting to link MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets (e.g., openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin) into an intermediate target. CMake prohibits linking MODULE_LIBRARY targets into other targets. This is a pre-existing CMake configuration issue in the Android build affecting multiple PRs entering the merge queue simultaneously. The bug is not in PR #37056 (GPU SDPA Transpose fusion) itself — the PR touches only GPU plugin source files, not CMake configuration.
reproduction_steps: Build OpenVINO for Android using cmake with android toolchain and observe CMake configure step failure.
recommended_actions: Fix `ov_generate_plugins_hpp()` / `ov_target_link_plugins()` in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 to not link MODULE_LIBRARY targets via target_link_libraries
This is a systemic issue affecting many merge-queue PRs — it needs to be fixed on master separately from this PR
Author of PR #37056 should re-add to merge queue once the CMake issue is resolved
prevention_strategies: The Android CMake configuration should be validated in CI before merging any PR that changes CMake configuration files. This recurring issue has affected many unrelated PRs.
historical_context: This same failure has occurred 9 times since 2026-08-08, affecting multiple PRs including #37064, #37211, #37304, and #37056. It is a systemic CMake configuration bug not related to any specific PR's code changes.
